title: Third Hellenic Republic
capsule: The Third Hellenic Republic is the parliamentary republic established in Greece following the 1974 collapse of the military junta (the Regime of the Colonels). It was inaugurated on 24 July 1974 when Konstantinos Karamanlis returned from exile to head a government of national unity (the metapolitefsi); a referendum on 8 December 1974 abolished the monarchy, and a new democratic constitution took effect on 11 June 1975. Karamanlis steered Greece into the European Communities in 1981, and the ensuing decades were defined by the alternation in power of his New Democracy party and Andreas Papandreou's PASOK.
